responsibility: This autogenerated companion to `gcc/d/lang.opt` supplies the option-to-manual URL mapping used by GCC’s generated option help and documentation machinery for the D frontend. For each D-relevant command-line switch, it records the Texinfo/HTML anchor suffix in the generic GCC manual, the GDC manual, or another language manual when options are shared, including cases where ambiguous options intentionally omit a default mapping. Its role is not to define or parse options, but to attach stable documentation targets to option-table entries so diagnostics, `--help` output, and generated docs can point users to the correct D or common option reference section.
